_comment: Curated: the former office holders shown by name in the Datenstory 'US-Lobby in Berlin' (revolving door). Only people with a public function (federal government, MPs) are named; former Bundestag staff are private persons and only counted. Everything that can change — end of office, position, the mandate and its spending range — is read live from public/data/lobby-mandates.json by scripts/build-datenstories.mjs. Here: who, which US register entries (usIds) the register names them for, via which agency, and the short labels for the chart. roleLabel/note/cardNote are frozen editorial text as of checkedOn. Source: recherche/slides-us-lobby/quellen.md (Folie 2).
